newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling gains against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling gains against the dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling posted marginal gains against the dollar on Thursday as exporter interest continued to surpass demand, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) posted a shilling mean rate of 56.46 against the dollar from 56.49 on Wednesday. On the pound, it was posted at an average of 87.80 from 87.93 on Wednesday.

"The market was jittery most of the day with the shilling trading within the bands of 56.35/65 against the dollar," a dealer said. "The day's trade reflected the local unit's resistance at the upper 56.00 levels."

"In addition exporter interest continued to surpass demand and despite Central Bank of Kenya intervention, the local unit edged to stronger 56.35/55 levels in the day. The range for the day is 56.35/55," she said.
A commercial banker said that stability for the shilling was mainly because of good buying at the 56.50 level.
Dealers said overnight money market rates shot up further to 24 percent levels as the the market tightened and most sought to raise funds rather than place (orders).
